stages.text:
Actual dispatch component; its governed callback is observed here. Backend signature/audit execution is qualified separately.

Dispatch · sequence 0000
dispatch readiness · QC
Dispatch is governed: a sequence must be Validated → Frozen (Part 11 e-signature) and clear the deterministic dispatch gate before it can be dispatched. The gate below is computed server-side from the canonical leaves and open Shadow Review criticals — the same gate the freeze/dispatch endpoints enforce atomically with the e-signature.
Dispatch gate clear except for the release signature — the dispatch e-signature applies it
The earlier release signature does not cover the current recorded facts. Re-signing applies a release signature to the current applicant, application and sequence content before any transmission.
0 validation errors · 0 unacknowledged shadow criticals · 1 shadow review run · 4 leaves · status Dispatched
Re-sign release for current recorded facts (Part 11 e-signature)
TEST PACKAGE
Assembles sequence 0000's leaves into an eCTD package on the server, reports what in those leaves would stop it being transmitted, and discards it. Nothing is sent. The test package carries no agency identifiers: its application number and applicant are placeholders, not the ones on record.
